ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Oman AML/CFT Law (Royal Decree No. 30/2016, as amended by Royal Decree No. 7/2020 and No. 90/2021), Central Bank of Oman AML/CFT Executive Rules (Circular BM 949), Commercial Companies Law (Royal Decree No. 18/2019) and implementing UBO/beneficial-owner register regulations, Commercial Registration Law (Royal Decree No. 3/1974), and Capital Market Authority Corporate Governance and Beneficial Ownership Disclosure requirements.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, managers, and authorized signatories against the Oman Central Bank sanctions list, UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN list, EU and UK consolidated sanctions lists, and independent PEP databases (World-Check or Dow Jones) prior to filing. Screening must be refreshed within 48 hours before submission, and evidence of screening must be retained for at least five years under Royal Decree No. 30/2016.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Invest Easy portal of the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be registered in Arabic script; a Latin transliteration may be added provided it faithfully corresponds to the Arabic name. The name must end with the SPC/LLC designation (or equivalent Arabic suffix 'شركة شخص واحد'). Names must not contravene public order, religion, or Omani naming conventions, and any foreign name must comply with MoCIIP transliteration guidelines.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within 10 working days of name rejection, the applicant may submit written administrative objection to the MoCIIP Commercial Registry Directorate through the Invest Easy portal, attaching name-availability evidence. If the objection is denied, the applicant may appeal to the Administrative Court (Board of Administrative Justice) within 30 days. A name reservation may be renewed once for an additional 30 days before expiry.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office arrangements are acceptable for low-risk advisory and consultancy activities provided the registered address is a real and physical location in Oman capable of receiving official notices and service of process. The MoCIIP accepts virtual office agreements for non-regulated sectors, but local bank account opening under Central Bank KYC norms requires a physical address and business substance evidence.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (<5%) - unannounced registry or tax inspections are rare for advisory and carbon auditing entities. However, if the carbon offset brokerage holds client funds or engages in brokerage of financial-style instruments, AML supervision may elevate the probability of an on-site inspection.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Commercial Companies Law of the Sultanate of Oman, Royal Decree No. 18/2019, as amended; Single Person Company provisions within the Limited Liability Company chapter, Articles 250 et seq.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) - Commercial Registry Department, through the Invest Easy e-portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association (Constitutive Contract) submitted as a Single Person Company incorporation application to the Commercial Registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is prescribed for a Single Person Company under Royal Decree No. 18/2019; the registered capital is fixed by the sole member in the constitutive contract. If declared capital is adopted, the full subscription amount must be deposited into an Oman-licensed bank escrow or current account opened in the company's name, and the bank deposit certificate must be attached to the Commercial Registry filing before issuance of the final registration certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT, subject to issuance of the Commercial Registration Certificate by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion, the sole shareholder's subscription of the company's declared capital is hereby approved, and the shares are allotted in full to the single member. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the registered office of the company shall be at the address stated in the constitutive contract, as notified to the Commercial Registry, and all statutory records and correspondence shall be maintained there. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT [Name] is appointed as General Manager/Director and [Name] as Company Secretary/Compliance Officer, each with authority to execute banking, contractual, and regulatory filings, until otherwise determined by the sole member.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MoCIIP - Commercial Registry via Invest Easy portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log in to the Invest Easy portal, file the name reservation application, select the legal form Single Person Company, and upload the passport copy of the sole foreign shareholder. Pay the name reservation fee and obtain the official name approval certificate.
required_dossiers: Passport copy of the sole shareholder
Proposed trade name and alternative names
Signed no-objection letter where the proposed name includes a foreign head office trademark
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity or prohibited meaning, amend the proposed name through the same portal within 15 working days; any formal refusal may be appealed to the Registrar of Companies with a written request and the Invest Easy transaction receipt.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and notarization of constitutive contract
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public, Ministry of Justice, Sultanate of Oman
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage an Oman-licensed legal counsel to draft the Arabic constitutive contract reflecting the Single Person Company provisions, registered capital, registered office, manager, auditor, and business objects. Execute the contract by the sole shareholder or by an attorney-in-fact, have it notarized at the Ministry of Justice, and pay the notarial stamping fees.
required_dossiers: Notarized power of attorney if signed by a representative
Passport copies of the sole shareholder and appointed manager
Registered office lease or preliminary address evidence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary returns the constitutive contract for correction, cure the drafting deficiencies, re-execute and re-notarize the document, and resubmit; the approved name reservation remains valid.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial registration application through Invest Easy
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit through Invest Easy the notarized constitutive contract, name approval certificate, and proposed activity codes matching ISIC 7020 / carbon accounting advisory services. Pay the commercial registration fees and obtain the electronic application reference.
required_dossiers: Capital deposit certificate where declared paid-up capital is adopted
Registered office lease agreement attested by the landlord
Passport copies and residential details of the sole shareholder and manager
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If MoCIIP raises a query, respond through the Invest Easy application dashboard within 10 working days with the requested clarification; if the application is rejected, file an administrative reconsideration request and resubmit corrected documentation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon system approval, download the electronic Commercial Registration (CR) certificate and the constitutive contract extract from Invest Easy. Verify the legal form, name, capital, objects, and registered office details before relying on the certificate for further registrations.
required_dossiers: Proof of fee payment generated by Invest Easy
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the issued CR certificate contains clerical errors, request a correction memorandum through Invest Easy; no additional commercial registration fee is charged for such correction when filed within 10 working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of corporate bank account and capital deposit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Central Bank of Oman licensed commercial banks
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate bank account at a licensed commercial bank in Muscat using the CR certificate, constitutive contract, passport copies, and beneficial ownership declarations. If declared capital is adopted, wire the full subscription amount into the corporate account and obtain a capital deposit certificate for the statutory records.
required_dossiers: Board resolution on bank signatory authorities
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank imposes enhanced due diligence because of 100% non-resident ownership, provide certified passport copies, source of funds evidence, and a bank reference letter; if the bank refuses without a legal basis, apply to another licensed bank or lodge a complaint with the Central Bank of Oman.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry; Oman Tax Authority; Ministry of Labour
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company with the Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry for membership, obtain the Oman Tax Authority tax identification number, and complete Ministry of Labour or manpower notifications if the company will hire staff. These registrations are prerequisites for lawful invoicing and employment.
required_dossiers: Passport copies of directors and managers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any authority identifies inconsistent data, reconcile the discrepancy by presenting the official CR extract and the constitutive contract; late notification penalties may be waived through a good-cause letter approved by the relevant compliance department.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adoption of first board resolutions and statutory records
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Sole member and appointed officers of the Single Person Company
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the formal first board meeting or adopt a written resolution of the sole member, approve the First Board Resolution, allot share certificates, and open the statutory registers including minutes, share ledger, and seal control register.
required_dossiers: Draft minutes of the first board meeting
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any appointed officer declines the position, convene an extraordinary resolution of the sole member to ratify a replacement and update the statutory registers and banking signatory records within 14 working days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for ISIC 7020 ESG carbon accounting and offset brokerage, which is classified as a professional advisory service rather than an industrial activity under the MoCIIP commercial activity classification.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No industrial operating permit or manufacturing license is required; the Commercial Registration certificate and the Oman Chamber of Commerce membership constitute the operating authorization for the advisory business.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environment Authority, Sultanate of Oman, under the Environmental Protection and Pollution Control Law, Royal Decree No. 114/2001, and the applicable Environmental Impact Assessment Regulations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - Category D low-impact office and professional service activity; no full Environmental Impact Assessment report is required because no manufacturing, hazardous discharge, or land disturbance is undertaken.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater, VOC, or process emission thresholds apply to a zero-discharge advisory office; municipal solid waste handling rules apply, and e-waste from office equipment must be transferred to Environment Authority approved recycling vendors.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: The registered office must satisfy Royal Oman Police Civil Defence requirements, including fire extinguishers, emergency exit signage, smoke alarms, and a Civil Defence fire safety certificate; structural safety is confirmed through the landlord's building completion certificate referenced in the lease, and occupational safety clearance for the office workplace must be maintained under Ministry of Labour workplace rules.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA), the national revenue authority for corporate income tax, withholding tax, and VAT; primary e-service portal: https://taxoman.gov.om (including the OTA Tax Management System and VAT e-registration/returns interfaces). Incorporated SPCs are additionally registered with the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) as the commercial-registry prerequisite.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Omani SPC must, in order: (1) incorporate under the Oman Companies Law and obtain the MoCIIP Commercial Registration (CR) certificate and SPC constitutive documents; (2) register for corporate income tax with the OTA through the e-Services portal (directly or via a licensed tax agent), submitting the CR, certified Arabic/English Articles, passport copies of the sole shareholder and manager, registered-address/lease evidence, bank account details, anticipated activity description, and an email/EGS account for OTA correspondence; (3) receive the OTA Tax Identification Number (TIN) and the annual Tax Card/Certificate of Registration before commencing activity; (4) notify the OTA within the statutory period of any change to shareholder, manager, address, or scope of activity; and (5) complete VAT registration separately and only when annual taxable supplies reach OMR 500,000 (mandatory) or decide to register voluntarily at OMR 50,000. A complete application is usually processed within 15 business days; late or incorrect registration exposes the SPC to fixed penalties and prevents issuance of valid VAT invoices.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Oman has no 'check-the-box' or pass-through election; a Single Person Company (SPC) is a resident juridical person taxed at entity level on worldwide taxable income under the Corporate Income Tax Law (Royal Decree No. 9/2017). Available statutory mechanisms include: the tax group/fiscal-unity election for resident companies under common ownership (85% or more direct/indirect) that file as a single taxable group with OTA approval; the election of the SPC's accounting year and consistent depreciation/capital-allowance pooling methods; the election to compute taxable income on an accrual basis; and the carry-forward of tax losses for a maximum of 5 years within the statutory continuity-of-activity conditions. Oman has adopted the OECD Multilateral Instrument, but domestic law does not provide a hybrid-mismatch or hybrid-entity election; cross-border hybrid arrangements are instead constrained by the general anti-avoidance rule and treaty-limitation-of-benefits principles.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) — GCC Unified VAT Agreement, implemented in Oman by the VAT Law (Royal Decree No. 121/2020) and its Executive Regulations.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: OMR 500,000 of annual taxable supplies and imports in any consecutive 12-month period (mandatory registration); OMR 50,000 of annual taxable supplies (voluntary registration threshold); a non-resident supplier making taxable supplies in Oman may be required to register without regard to the threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: The OTA is implementing a phased mandatory e-invoicing and fiscal-data-clearance mandate for VAT-registered businesses. In-scope taxpayers must generate structured e-invoices and credit notes in the OTA-specified format (XML/UBL), apply a digital signature/unique identifier per invoice, and transmit datasets to the OTA in near real-time via secured APIs for validation/clearance; once a phase is effective, only digitally cleared invoices entitle the customer to input VAT deduction. Phase I applies to large/priority taxpayers, with subsequent phases covering smaller VAT registrants. Taxpayers not yet in the active phase must issue statutory VAT invoices containing all Arabic/English mandatory fields, retain machine-readable records, and reconcile export zero-rated sales to OTA audit queries.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to the export of goods physically removed from Oman to a place outside the implementing GCC States and to services supplied to a non-resident recipient established outside Oman/GCC where the place of supply and the place of benefit are outside Oman. For the ESG climate/carbon audit and offset-brokerage activity, eligibility requires: (i) a written contract with a non-resident client identifying the services and foreign place of use; (ii) delivery of the audit report/carbon-assurance deliverables and broker confirmations to the foreign recipient; (iii) the fees are invoiced to the foreign entity and settled from abroad in foreign currency; and (iv) the services are not performed or consumed in relation to immovable property or goods located in Oman. Fee-based carbon-accounting/audit services are zero-rated; however, carbon-offset brokerage margins can be classified as exempt financial services under the VAT law, in which case input VAT is non-recoverable. The SPC should separate audit and brokerage engagements contractually and obtain a formal OTA ruling where the brokerage element is material. All zero-rated transactions must nevertheless be disclosed in the VAT return with the applicable export evidence retained for not less than 5 years.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Oman Customs electronic declaration output) evidencing the physical export of goods
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill or multimodal transport document evidencing movement from Oman to the foreign destination
Inward Remittance Certificate / Omani bank credit advice evidencing receipt of the export consideration in foreign currency
Signed export contract, commercial invoice, and detailed scope-of-work/services agreement
Foreign recipient tax existence certificate / VAT registration certificate issued outside the GCC implementing States
Deliverable evidence: ESG/carbon audit report, assurance statement, and offset-broker transaction confirmations addressed to the foreign client
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The OTA may reopen a VAT period for audit within 5 years. Export zero-rating is accepted only if the complete customs-clearance, transport, contract, and foreign-currency receipt documentation is on file; any missing or inconsistent document recharacterizes the supply as standard-rated, triggering 5% output VAT, disallowance of associated input VAT, and administrative penalties of 25%-50% of the understated tax plus monthly late-payment interest at 1%. Fraudulent export claims (false customs declarations, backdated or fictitious invoices, sham remittances, shell foreign recipients, or collusive offset schemes) attract aggravated penalties up to 200% of the evaded tax, fines up to OMR 100,000, imprisonment of responsible persons, suspension/withdrawal of VAT registration, loss of e-invoicing clearance privileges, and public blacklisting by the OTA.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Omani Rial (OMR) is fully convertible on both current and capital account. The CBO maintains a de jure currency peg to the US dollar at 1 USD = 0.3845 OMR, with a quoted trading band of +/-0.0147 OMR per USD. No exchange control license is required for inward FDI equity subscriptions, current international trade settlements, debt servicing, or profit repatriation. The only substantive hurdle is documentary and tax clearance: a foreign-owned Single Person Company must be in full compliance with Oman Corporate Income Tax (tax clearance certificate issued by the Oman Tax Authority), and payments routed through licensed banks must include underlying commercial or contractual documentation for AML purposes. There are no general restrictions on converting OMR into USD or transferring dividends abroad, but banks may enforce de minimis anti-money-laundering limits on cash-based remittances.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Oman imposes no statutory surrender or mandatory conversion requirements on export proceeds. Exporters may retain 100% of foreign-currency export receipts in duly licensed bank accounts within Oman or offshore accounts opened with CBO-approved banks. The Export Proceeds Retention regime permits direct crediting to corporate accounts, with no due-date conversion obligation. However, all export receipts must be traceable to commercial invoices and subject to CBO reporting thresholds for balance-of-payments statistical compilation.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW. Offshore digital EMIs and virtual-account providers are not recognized as licensed banks in Oman under the Banking Law (Royal Decree 114/2000) and the CBO's Payment Service Provider Regulation. Such providers cannot accept deposits, open current accounts, or provide local clearing access in OMR. Cross-border monetary processing through an offshore EMI may be allowed only as a payment gateway for ancillary fees, but it cannot serve as the principal treasury rail for equity capital, trade disbursements, or payroll. Any licensed fintech activity requires a CBO Payment Service Provider licence or a banking agent arrangement with a tier-1 local commercial bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: As a general rule, each authorised signatory and at least one corporate director must attend an in-person KYC interview at the bank's Oman branch. Remote onboarding has become partially feasible since the CBO issued the 2020 KYC and Customer Due Diligence Guidelines, but it is subject to each bank's internal risk appetite and requires a prior, verifiable foreign-banking relationship with satisfactory correspondent KYC. For a Single Person Company with a direct non-resident shareholder, the physical presence mandate remains strictly applied at Board level; remote video verification alone is unlikely to satisfy all tier-1 Omani banks without a coexisting existing-relationship referral.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) is a foreign natural person with no prior Omani banking footprint
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of the Single Person Company's constitutive deed and Commercial Registration (CR); audited ownership chart showing the natural-person UBO; UBO passport and visa/residence permit (if resident); notarised board resolution authorising account opening; bank-issued existing-customer reference or a letter of comfort from the foreign parent bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border wire transfers attributable to carbon credit brokerage with counterparties in high-risk or sanctioned jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed carbon-offset service invoices and sale/purchase agreements; independent registry evidence (e.g. Gold Standard, Verra) demonstrating legitimate underlying assets; chain-of-custody documentation for each credit; economic-sanctions screening by a reputable screening vendor; corporate tax residency certificate and tax return filings for the SPC; CBO residency/address verification documents.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High velocity of payments without a proportional operational footprint or payroll substance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Annual audited accounts or management accounts showing fees earned and expenses paid; lease agreement and utility bills for the Omani registered office; employee contracts and social security / pension enrolment records for any local staff; the SPC's ISIC 7020 emissions-audit methodology documentation; a targeted KYC questionnaire addressing source of wealth and source of funds for all principal counterparties.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inward direct investment equity subscriptions must be routed via SWIFT MT103 from the foreign parent bank directly to the SPC's OMR or foreign-currency account at a CBO-licensed commercial bank. The payment instruction should reference the SPC's Commercial Registration number, the legal basis (share capital contribution under the Oman Companies Law), and the statement 'Direct investment – equity subscription' in the remittance information. Oman does not maintain a mandatory national purpose-code list, but the receiving bank will map the remittance to the CBO's balance-of-payments direct-investment classification, typically 'Direct Investment – Equity Capital'. For any capital injection above bank internal thresholds, the bank will require a board resolution approving the capital call, the SPC's CR and Articles, and a copy of the FDI notification filed with the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (if applicable).
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound payments for trade settlements are executed via SWIFT MT103 (telegraphic transfer) for open account transactions and via SWIFT MT700 (documentary letter of credit) for LC-based imports or exports. All outward wires must be supported by underlying invoices, purchase orders, and relevant customs/import evidence where available. Payments in USD and EUR clear through correspondent banking networks (primarily US and European respondent banks); OMR-denominated domestic disbursements clear through the CBO's RTGS (Oman Real Time Gross Settlement) system. For carbon credit pre-payments and brokerage aggregations, banks may require a settlement matrix listing the actual beneficiaries, a description of the carbon units transacted, and a commitment not to route payments through restrictive jurisdictions.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forward contracts (USD/OMR and commonly traded GCC currencies)
Non-deliverable FX forwards (NDFs) for exotic or non-pegged currency pairs through bank offshore desks
Islamic currency swaps (Wa'd-based) approved by Shari'a boards and the CBO
Currency options (limited to plain-vanilla OTC structures with licensed commercial banks)

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) - Invest Easy commercial registry portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the CR issuance anniversary; renewal window opens 30 days before expiry.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: OMR 100 late fee for delay up to 30 days and OMR 200 for delay beyond 30 days; CR suspension after 12 months of non-renewal and administrative strike-off after two consecutive missed renewals.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: MoCIIP - Real Beneficiary Disclosure module linked to the National AML/CFT database
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed simultaneously with the annual CR renewal; any share transfer or ownership change must additionally be declared within 30 days.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine of OMR 500-3,000 for omission or false UBO data; repeated breaches block CR renewal and may disqualify the manager.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax Return and Final Tax Payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after the fiscal year-end; calendar-year filers must submit and pay by 30 April.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: OMR 100 late-filing penalty; 2% monthly interest on unpaid tax; estimated assessment and enforced collection (bank attachment) if the return remains outstanding beyond 12 months.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Statutory Financial Statements and Audit Report Deposit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: MoCIIP Commercial Registry (shared electronically with OTA)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after the financial year-end, tendered with the annual CR renewal package.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: CR renewal rejection; OMR 100-500 fine for non-deposit; loss of micro-entity reviewed-status for the following year.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI) Annual Subscription
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (mandatory public-law chamber)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary of CR issuance; OCCI certificate is a precondition of CR renewal.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Chamber certificate withheld, blocking CR renewal and issuance of import/export and customs permits.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Muscat Municipality or Governorate Baladiyah of the registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual anniversary of the premises license issuance.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: OMR 50 monthly late fee; closure order and prohibition of commercial activity at unlicensed premises.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Every SPC must appoint an Omani-licensed auditor. A full statutory audit is compulsory when annual turnover exceeds OMR 50,000 (~USD 130,000) or gross assets exceed OMR 100,000; below this threshold MoCIIP/OTA accept reviewed financial statements, but if audited accounts exist they must be attached to the CIT return.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as issued by the IASB is the sole reporting framework for Omani commercial companies; no separate national GAAP is permitted. CCL statutory books are retained 7 years, overlapping the OTA 10-year tax record requirement.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: At each CR anniversary the SPC must re-certify the Real Beneficiary statement through the MoCIIP portal. The sole shareholder is treated as the ultimate beneficial owner unless another natural person exercises control. Share transfers must be recorded in the Register of Members and filed as a UBO update within 30 days; the annual confirmation is mandatory even when there is no ownership change.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Statutory Minute Book (sole shareholder and manager written resolutions)
General accounting records and underlying contracts

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 800-1,800 per annum in Muscat; covers registered office address, mail handling and regulatory correspondence service.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,000-5,500 for a low-risk ESG/carbon advisory SPC depending on offset-transaction volume and number of delegated review reports.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general tax holiday applies to a foreign-owned Single Person Company engaged in ISIC 7020 carbon footprint auditing and offset brokerage. The 3% reduced rate is reserved for SMEs meeting specific Omani ownership and size thresholds and is therefore unavailable to a 100% foreign-owned SPC. Sectoral economic-zone exemptions (e.g., Duqm, Salalah Free Zone) may be available only if the SPC obtains a qualifying free-zone licence; no such licence is presumed. The principal statutory relief is the 5-year tax loss carryforward; no carry-back exists.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Form 8 referenced in the Oman Income Tax Law implementing regulations), filed electronically through the Oman Tax Authority e-Services portal (tax.gov.om, Dharib e-filing system).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual return and settlement are due no later than the statutorily prescribed filing date, in practice by 30 April following the fiscal year-end for calendar-year taxpayers unless the Oman Tax Authority grants a formal extension. The fiscal year is normally 1 January to 31 December; a different fiscal year may be adopted only with prior approval and must be consistently applied.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered legal name, Oman Tax Registration Number (TRN), Commercial Registration (CR) number, SPC incorporation date and single-shareholder details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the Oman TRN exactly as shown on the Oman Tax Authority registration certificate. The foreign sole shareholder's name and country of residence must be disclosed in the ownership schedule, but a foreign tax identification number cannot be substituted for the Omani TRN.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 - Tax Period and Basis of Accounting
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Start and end dates of the tax period, accounting standard used, and whether audited financial statements are attached.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A 31 December 2024 fiscal year must be reported as 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31. The foreign shareholder is not itself required to file this return; the Oman-resident SPC remains the reporting taxpayer for all Oman-source and assessable foreign-source income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Global revenue split between Oman-source and foreign-source income, with operating revenue from carbon audit fees and offset brokerage commissions separately disclosed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Omani SPC is a tax resident by incorporation and is assessable on worldwide income unless a specific source rule or double-tax treaty excludes it. The foreign parent's consolidated revenue does not belong in Box 3; only the SPC's own income must be reported.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Claimed business deductions, mandatory disallowances (entertainment and non-commercial expenses), ESG certification costs supported by invoices, and carried-forward tax losses (maximum five years).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Expenses invoiced by a foreign related-party carbon registry or offset provider are deductible only at arm's length and only if the SPC demonstrates actual receipt of service, supported by contracts and invoice documentation. Tax losses may be carried forward for five years only, with no carry-back.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Aggregate taxable income, calculated tax at 15%, any foreign tax credit claimed, and the final net tax payable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Do not apply the 3% reduced SME rate unless the SPC qualifies under the Omani ownership and small-enterprise thresholds. A 100% foreign-owned SPC ordinarily files at 15%; misapplication of the reduced rate exposes the entity to understatement assessments and penalties.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of Omani withholding tax on payments to non-residents for interest, royalties and certain cross-border service fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The SPC is the payer and must report and remit 10% withholding tax on assessable payments to non-resident recipients if the recipient has no Omani permanent establishment. The non-resident beneficiary cannot self-assess; the withholding obligation is imposed on the Omani payer.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 7 - Transfer Pricing and Supporting Schedules
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Attachments for audited financial statements, related-party transaction details, transfer pricing Local File or Master File if thresholds are met, and beneficial ownership declarations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Upload the Omani SPC's Local File where related-party transactions exceed the Oman Tax Authority threshold. Foreign parent group documentation alone does not satisfy the SPC's separate filing duty.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts an administrative penalty of OMR 100 to OMR 1,000 per period plus a daily or monthly delay surcharge, not exceeding approximately 25% of the assessed tax, at the Tax Authority's discretion. Unpaid tax bears monthly late-payment interest. Fraudulent failure to file or knowingly incorrect returns can be escalated to tax evasion proceedings with fines equal to the underpaid tax and potential criminal prosecution.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% (Oman imposes no dividend withholding tax at source; a dividend paid by an Omani SPC to a foreign sole shareholder is not subject to Omani withholding tax).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim relief under an Oman income tax treaty for interest or royalties, the beneficial owner must obtain a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) for the relevant calendar year from its country of residence, complete the related-party declaration and treaty-relief form on the Oman Tax Authority e-portal, and submit the TRC together with supporting beneficial-ownership evidence before the payment is processed. Oman Tax Authority may require certification of business purpose and substance; if relief is granted after payment, a refund claim may be filed within the statutory time limits.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory WHT is 10% on cross-border royalties and interest paid to non-residents without an Omani permanent establishment. Treaty rates may reduce or eliminate this WHT depending on the treaty partner, typically to 0% for interest paid to financial institutions meeting bona fide lender conditions and 5-10% for royalties. No WHT applies to dividend distributions.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Oman Local File and Master File obligations are triggered when aggregate related-party controlled transactions exceed OMR 1,000,000 in a tax year; Master File and Country-by-Country Report obligations arise when the multinational group's consolidated revenue exceeds OMR 75,000,000. The Oman Tax Authority may lower these thresholds on notice or by audit determination.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Oman has no standalone Economic Substance Regulations regime comparable to UAE Cabinet Resolution 31/2019, but the Income Tax Law's general anti-abuse rules, substance-over-form doctrine, and the OECD BEPS minimum standards effectively require an SPC to maintain real board decision-making, active management, personnel, business facilities, and risk-carrying functions in Oman. Carbon offset brokerage models that rely on offshore intermediaries without local commercial substance risk Lease-Tax rejection of treaty benefits and denial of expense deductions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Willfully understating carbon-offset brokerage revenue, creating fictitious carbon credit invoices, inflating deductions, backdating contracts, or submitting materially false information in the annual return.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Additional tax equal to the tax evaded, administrative fines up to 25% of underpaid tax, monthly late-payment surcharges, and criminal prosecution under the Oman Income Tax Law and Penal Code. Conviction may result in imprisonment of up to three years and fines not less than OMR 1,000 and not more than OMR 50,000, with mandatory disqualification from government contracts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Where fraud is proved, the court may pierce the SPC's corporate veil and the sole shareholder/director becomes jointly and severally liable for all unpaid tax; travel restriction orders, asset seizure and confiscation of unlawful gains apply.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing and Artificial Shell Arrangements
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Use of a related-party carbon trading platform in a zero-tax jurisdiction to absorb margin from the Omani SPC; absence of local staff; intercompany service fees without demonstrable functions performed; failure to prepare or file Local File/Master File despite controlled transactions above the threshold.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Oman Tax Authority may reprice the controlled transaction to arm's length, disallow excessive deductions, tax the SPC on 15% of revised taxable income, impose penalties up to 25% of the underpaid tax, and charge late-payment interest. A deeming may also create a permanent establishment of the foreign parent in Oman.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approve non-arm's length charges and stripped-profit arrangements may be joined as collection defendants when the SPC is found to be an artificial conduit; court-ordered restitution, directors' disqualification, travel bans and, in cases of fraudulent enrichment, imprisonment up to five years may be imposed.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML, Beneficial Ownership and Shell Company Misuse
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the SPC as a nominee instrumentality for undisclosed third-party carbon credit trading; concealing ultimate beneficial ownership; failing to undertake customer due diligence on offset buyers; processing wire transfers for non-transparent ESG schemes; using shell holding structures without any economic activity in Oman.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Oman AML Law (Royal Decree 30/2016) and the Commercial Companies Law obligations, sanctions include monetary penalties of up to OMR 50,000, revocation of the Commercial Registration licence, confiscation of funds linked to illegal offsets, and criminal prosecution with imprisonment up to five years for money laundering or financing of prohibited activities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The single shareholder, managers and compliance officers face personal fines and imprisonment. Beneficial owners using the SPC to conceal carbon assets risk civil asset forfeiture; directors may be personally ordered to reverse dividends or payments made without substance.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Misclassifying cross-border royalty or interest payments as exempt dividends, paying non-resident service providers without withholding 10% tax where applicable, claiming treaty relief with a defective Tax Residency Certificate, or failing to register a foreign parent activity in Oman as a permanent establishment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Omani payer SPC is liable for the un-withheld 10% tax, interest, and penalties up to 25% of the amount; the Tax Authority may additionally treat the payment as non-deductible. Intentional misclassification is criminally sanctioned as tax evasion with fines and imprisonment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly approve unlawful payments and foreign shareholders receiving tainted distributions can be held personally liable for withholding deficiencies; asset seizure, bank account freezes, and travel bans are available enforcement tools.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Issuing carbon audit verification statements or offset brokerage confirmations without verified underlying data, selling fraudulent carbon offset units, or claiming non-existent tax advantages for carbon credits in Oman.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Regulatory fines and licence revocation under Omani standards bodies and anti-fraud laws; any tax deduction derived from a sham carbon purchase is disallowed, and penalties plus interest are imposed on the recomputed tax liability; criminal fraud sanctions apply where the misrepresentation causes investor loss.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The director who signs the audit opinion or trades fraudulent offsets bears personal civil liability to affected counterparties. Oman courts may award compensation, impose travel bans, and refer the matter for fraud prosecution with potential imprisonment.
